title: Zigzag line at the density slider's maximum
description: An open line (10,20)-(50,20)-(50,40) mm sewn as zigzag at PE-DESIGN's highest density. Fits the density mapping. PE-DESIGN's maximum is 14.0 lines/mm (MANIFEST settings of the reference).

evidence.note: docs/COMPATIBILITY_AUDIT.md, Uncalibrated numeric defaults (line pitch, line widths)
line sew types and their attributes

references.make: On a 100 x 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw an open straight line by clicking (10, 20), (50, 20) and double-clicking (50, 40) mm. Region Not Sewn. Line sew type Zigzag Stitch, colour 800 RED, Density 14.0 line/mm, the maximum, every other line attribute at its default (record the density value shown). Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system, every line attribute PE-DESIGN shows for the type with its value, and the status-bar size and stitch count in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
